Specification: This module defines an alternative hour-clock specification named HC2 for the clock model introduced in the extended module HourClock. It introduces a next-state action HCnxt2 that advances the hour by setting hr' to (hr % 12) + 1, and defines HC2 as the conjunction of the inherited initial condition HCini with the temporal formula [][HCnxt2]_hr. The module also states a theorem asserting that the inherited specification HC is equivalent to HC2, showing that the alternative next-state formulation yields the same behavior.
